description: The same three judgements on the second language, plus the shape that hides best: a version 1 UUID is the clock and a MAC address, and is indistinguishable at a glance from a version 4 one.

expected.note: a version 1 UUID is a timestamp and a node identifier written down; it is the same shape and length as a random one
seeded from the clock, so the sequence is recomputable
token_hex counts bytes rather than characters, so four bytes is thirty-two bits
